messages.subject: Supply Agreement — executed and dated 28 April 2025
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

I'm pleased to confirm that the Supply Agreement between Harrow Precision Engineering Limited and Stratton Energy plc has been executed and dated today, 28 April 2025. A PDF of the fully executed agreement is attached for your records.

Thank you all for a smooth negotiation. Stratton can now begin placing orders under the agreement.

Kind regards,
James Osei

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
